content:
Build the main landing page index.php at /var/www/projects/nexifynewweb/index.php by mirroring .reference/indexnewnexify.html EXACTLY (layout, colors, fonts, sections, content).

Requirements:
- Convert the static HTML to PHP using includes/header.php and includes/footer.php
- Use RELATIVE paths only (libs/tailwind.js, css/style.css, images/foo.png — NEVER http://localhost/...)
- Reference local libs only (libs/tailwind.js, libs/alpine.min.js, libs/fontawesome.min.css)
- Add data-testid attributes on interactive elements (buttons, nav links, forms)
- Mobile-responsive (test at 375x812 viewport)
- Add proper <meta> tags, title, description

Verification (mandatory before marking done):
1. php -l index.php → no syntax errors
2. Screenshot tool: Screenshot(url='https://127.0.0.1:{PROJECTS_PORT}/nexifynewweb/', capture_mode='smart')
3. No console errors
4. Compare side-by-side with .reference/indexnewnexify.html screenshot — they must look the same
5. Check sudo tail -30 /var/log/nginx/codehero-projects-error.log
